import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    static final int N = 210;
    static final int MAX_T = 65;
    static final int MAX_N = 15;
    static final int MAX_CAP = 15;
    static final int MAX_STATE = MAX_N * MAX_N * 2; // maximum number of nodes for source/sink
    static final int[][] b = {{0,1},{0,-1},{1,0},{-1,0}};
    
    static class Edge {
        int to, w, next;
        public Edge(int to, int w, int next) {
            this.to = to;
            this.w = w;
            this.next = next;
        }
    }
    
    static int n, t, st, ed, cnt;
    static int[][] cap = new int[MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static int[][] sci = new int[MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static int[][][] maze = new int[MAX_T][MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static int[] head = new int[N];
    static Edge[] edges = new Edge[N * N * 4]; // enough size
    static int[] d = new int[N];
    static int[] now = new int[N];
    static boolean[][] vis = new boolean[MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static boolean[][][][][] dp = new boolean[MAX_T][MAX_N][MAX_N][MAX_N][MAX_N];
    
    static int edgeCount = 0;
    
    static int get_id(int x, int y, int k) {
        return (x - 1) * n + y + k * n * n;
    }
    
    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int w) {
        edges[edgeCount] = new Edge(v, w, head[u]);
        head[u] = edgeCount++;
        edges[edgeCount] = new Edge(u, 0, head[v]);
        head[v] = edgeCount++;
    }
    
    static boolean bfs(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(d, 0);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(s);
        now[s] = head[s];
        d[s] = 1;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int i = head[u]; i != -1; i = edges[i].next) {
                int v = edges[i].to;
                int w = edges[i].w;
                if (d[v] != 0 || w == 0) continue;
                d[v] = d[u] + 1;
                now[v] = head[v];
                q.offer(v);
                if (v == t) return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    static int dinic(int x, int t, int flow) {
        if (x == t) return flow;
        int rest = flow;
        for (int i = now[x]; i != -1 && rest > 0; i = edges[i].next) {
            int v = edges[i].to;
            int w = edges[i].w;
            if (w != 0 && d[v] == d[x] + 1) {
                int k = dinic(v, t, Math.min(rest, w));
                if (k == 0) d[v] = 0;
                edges[i].w -= k;
                edges[i ^ 1].w += k;
                rest -= k;
            }
        }
        now[x] = -1;
        return flow - rest;
    }
    
    static int solve(int s, int t) {
        int ans = 0, flow;
        while (bfs(s, t)) {
            while ((flow = dinic(s, t, INF)) > 0) {
                ans += flow;
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }
    
    static void dfs(int x, int y, int xx, int yy, int step) {
        vis[xx][yy] = true;
        dp[step][x][y][xx][yy] = true;
        if (step >= t || maze[step][xx][yy] != 0) return;
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
            int nx = xx + b[k][0];
            int ny = yy + b[k][1];
            if (nx <= 0 || ny <= 0 || nx > n || ny > n) continue;
            if (vis[nx][ny]) continue;
            if (maze[step][nx][ny] != 0) continue;
            dfs(x, y, nx, ny, step + 1);
        }
    }
    
    static void init() {
        Arrays.fill(now, 0);
        Arrays.fill(head, -1);
        edgeCount = 0;
        for (int time = 1; time <= t; time++) {
            for (int x = 1; x <= n; x++) {
                for (int y = 1; y <= n; y++) {
                    if (maze[time - 1][x][y] != 0)
                        maze[time][x][y] = maze[time - 1][x][y];
                    else {
                        for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                            int xx = x + b[k][0];
                            int yy = y + b[k][1];
                            if (xx <= 0 || yy <= 0 || xx > n || yy > n) continue;
                            if (maze[time - 1][xx][yy] == 2)
                                maze[time][x][y] = 2;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (sci[i][j] != 0) {
                    for (boolean[] row1 : vis) Arrays.fill(row1, false);
                    dfs(i, j, i, j, 0);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= t; i++) {
            for (int x = 1; x <= n; x++) {
                for (int y = 1; y <= n; y++) {
                    for (int xx = 1; xx <= n; xx++) {
                        for (int yy = 1; yy <= n; yy++) {
                            dp[i][x][y][xx][yy] |= dp[i - 1][x][y][xx][yy];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer stz = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(stz.nextToken());
        t = Integer.parseInt(stz.nextToken());
        st = N - 1;
        ed = st - 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            head[i] = -1;
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String s = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                char c = s.charAt(j - 1);
                if (Character.isDigit(c))
                    sci[i][j] = c - '0';
                else if (c == 'Y')
                    maze[0][i][j] = 1;
                else if (c == 'Z')
                    maze[0][i][j] = 2;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String s = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                char c = s.charAt(j - 1);
                if (Character.isDigit(c))
                    cap[i][j] = c - '0';
            }
        }
        init();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (sci[i][j] != 0)
                    addEdge(st, get_id(i, j, 0), sci[i][j]);
                if (cap[i][j] != 0)
                    addEdge(get_id(i, j, 1), ed, cap[i][j]);
            }
        }
        for (int x = 1; x <= n; x++) {
            for (int y = 1; y <= n; y++) {
                for (int xx = 1; xx <= n; xx++) {
                    for (int yy = 1; yy <= n; yy++) {
                        if (sci[x][y] != 0 && cap[xx][yy] != 0 && dp[t][x][y][xx][yy]) {
                            addEdge(get_id(x, y, 0), get_id(xx, yy, 1), INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(solve(st, ed));
    }
}
